why: Intro to Jupyter plan, 'Run order and what the kernel keeps' (passes when the last output compares against the new goal of 8000): the learner typed goal = 8000 but only re-ran the print cell, so the kernel still holds 10000 and the output says '2 of 7 days reached the goal of 10000'. The goal cell's count (2) is older than the print cell's (4).

step.title: Change the goal and see what the kernel keeps
step.instructions: In steps.ipynb, change goal to 8000 in the second cell, then re-run it and the cell below so the last output compares the steps against the new goal.

targets.caption: Set the new goal, then re-run

checks.label: Comparison with the new goal printed

cells.source:
goal = 8000
days_met = sum(s >= goal for s in steps)
print(f'{days_met} of 7 days reached the goal of {goal}')
